name: slice2-typecheck
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun run typecheck > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/typecheck.log" 2>&1; bunx oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config research/bapa/*.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/lint.log" 2>&1

name: no-given-helper-search
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/install.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/search-lock-server.ts > "$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR/search.log" 2>&1
